title: Proceedings Of The 19th Annual Meeting Of The Asia Oceania Geosciences Society (Aogs 2022)
bookshelves: Category: Earth Sciences, Geography, Environment, Planning
summary: The 19th Annual Meeting of the Asia Oceania Geosciences Society (AOGS 2022) was held from 1st to 5th August 2022. This proceedings volume includes selected extended abstracts from a challenging array of presentations at this conference. The AOGS Annual Meeting is a leading venue for professional interaction among researchers and practitioners, covering diverse disciplines of geosciences.
